structures.name: Coastal watchtower
structures.description: A limestone sentinel, timber floors and a sheltered lean-to. Built to outlast its keepers.

structures.name: Hillside chapel
structures.description: A thatched nave and a stone bell tower. Watch the roof give way to an open sky.

structures.name: Courtyard villa
structures.description: A colonnaded courtyard wrapped in timber galleries. Long spans, quiet gardens.

structures.name: Forest cottage
structures.description: Timber walls on a low stone footing, beneath a steep thatched roof.
